HypersensoryAbilities.description: The first time each enemy turn that <style="Faction_Genestealers">Judh</style> is attacked, she cannot fall below <style="Stat">{[hpPct]}%</style> of her current <style="Stat_Health">Health</style>. After the attack, she moves to a free adjacent hex and places a <style="Decoy">decoy</style> on the hex she moved from. Then, if she is within {[range]} hexes of the unit that attacked her, she deals <style="Stat_Hits">{[nrOfHits]}x</style> <style="DMG_Projectile">{[minDmg]}-{[maxDmg]} Projectile Damage</style> to that unit.
